plan.early: Poke with Impale through the wave, keep Harden Carapace for their mage rotation, never burn Burrow Charge in; it is your only out
plan.mid: Cocoon at 10: Burrow Charge the healer, Cocoon them, Impale the peelers. Start every objective fight with your engage or don't start it
plan.fight: Burrow the backline mage, Cocoon the healer, then turn and Impale divers off your carry. No charge without follow-up in range
plan.late: Epicenter at 16 widens your engage, but sustained AAs melt you late. Carapace eats spell burst; disengage when it is down

anubarak.solo: Can offlane vs casters thanks to Harden Carapace spell shield, but AA bruisers like Leoric and Sonya run him out of lane

plan.early: Trade with Twin Blades then back off; Blade Dash through the wave to cycle Shield Overload. Don't spend Dash as pure damage
plan.mid: Suppression Pulse at 10: blind their AA core as fights start, then Phase Prism swap their squishiest into your team
plan.fight: Prism-swap the backline carry into your team, Dash out after. Engage when Shield Overload is up, disengage when it is down
plan.late: You win long brawls: Force of Will at 16 keeps shields rolling. Blinds and roots kill you; hold Dash to escape, not chase

artanis.solo: Solid solo: out-trades sustain bruisers with Twin Blades and shield cycling; blinds (Johanna, Li Li) and Leoric make his lane miserable

plan.early: Hit BOTH Flame Streams on the enemy laner, drop Oil Spill on globes to zone, hold Jet Propulsion strictly for ganks
plan.mid: Bunker Drop at 10: drop it ON your team when their burst lands; everyone ports in, walks out with flamethrowers rolling
plan.fight: Ignite Oil Spill under their divers, body-block for your carry, save Jet to peel. Bunker beats Mosh and Apocalypse combos
plan.late: Juggernaut Plating at 16 makes you unkillable in oil, but percent damage still shreds you. Never fight with Bunker on CD

blaze.solo: Comfortable solo: double-soaks with long-range streams and bullies melee bruisers; Leoric and Malthael percent damage beat him

plan.early: Keg Smash into Breath of Fire, weave AAs to refill brew. Drink behind the wave and bait their interrupt before committing
plan.mid: Wandering Keg at 10: bowl their team off the objective or roll one tank into your side. Never keg enemies onto your own backline
plan.fight: Stagger their engage: Flying Kick the diver, Keg Smash slow, drink through the burst. Your job is soaking CDs, not chasing kills
plan.late: You win by attrition, but every stun cancels your brew. Bait CC first, drink after; Purifying Brew at 20 removes that weakness

chen.solo: Strong solo: out-sustains Sonya and Mal'Ganis style traders; Yrel and stun-heavy laners who cancel Fortifying Brew bully him

plan.early: Boosters between two lanes to double-soak; de-meched, Big Shot the wave, hero hits refund Call Mech. Matrix their AA laner in trades
plan.mid: Bunny Hop at 10: wait for their frontline to commit, then hop the clump and keep 3+ perma-stunned on the objective
plan.fight: Defense Matrix the Tychus or Valla, Boosters to peel your healer, throw Self-Destruct into the choke as zone denial
plan.late: Losing mech to CC plus burst mid-fight is your death spiral: Matrix BEFORE stuns land, keep Self-Destruct charged for resets

dva.solo: Great solo: absurdly hard to kill and Boosters double-soak; Leoric out-trades pilot form and percent damage melts the mech

plan.early: Stack souls fast: trade with Shadow Charge into Overpower under your own gate, Fire Stomp the wave. At 100 souls play fearless
plan.mid: Lightning Breath at 10: flip a target with Overpower first, then breathe while Unstoppable. Charge their mage on objectives
plan.fight: Charge a squishy into your team, or Overpower their diver back onto your carry as the peel. Aim Fire Stomps into the clump
plan.late: Hellgate at 20 flips fights alone, but at 0 souls you are paper. Never chain deaths; the 100-soul buff IS your tankiness

diablo.solo: Workable solo with Fire Stomp sustain, punishes immobile laners near walls; percent damage and Garrosh tosses ruin him

plan.early: Play safe soak, heal with Guitar Solo, slide only through the wave with an exit. Powerslide is engage AND escape, never both
plan.mid: Mosh Pit at 10: slide-stun only when it does not risk your Mosh; Face Melt their engage, then Mosh the re-clump on objectives
plan.fight: Powerslide the backline, hold Mosh for a 3+ clump, count their interrupts first. Face Melt peels divers off your healer
plan.late: A landed late Mosh wins the game and a cancelled one loses it. Track every enemy stun and channel-breaker before you press R

etc.solo: Rarely solos; only offlane on huge maps with a Stage Dive build, otherwise keep him main tank

plan.early: Trade under your tower: Groundbreaker pull, Wrecking Ball toss into tower shots, Bloodthirst back up. You are strongest at low HP
plan.mid: Decimate at 10: spam the slow on objectives and toss their bruiser into your team the second your mage has cooldowns
plan.fight: Toss the diver off your healer, or flip their carry into your team. Armor Up means you tank BETTER while low; don't panic out
plan.late: Late, every Wrecking Ball should trade a kill. Watch for Unstoppable and Iron Skin timers; toss the target who cannot answer

garrosh.solo: Fine solo: nearly ungankable at low HP under tower; loses pure sustain wars to Mal'Ganis and percent-damage laners

plan.early: Punish the melee laner on CD, Shield Glare their AA windows, Iron Skin AFTER their stun commits. Condemn drags the wave for clears
plan.mid: Blessed Shield at 10: open fights by stunning two, or bank it to interrupt Mosh Pit and Ring of Frost on objectives
plan.fight: Walk at their carry, Condemn pull into Punish, keep the AA hero Glared all fight. Iron Skin their engage; you cannot be peeled
plan.late: Your risk is tanking with no threat: hit multi-hero Glares for Holy Renewal at 16 and hold Iron Skin to eat their wombo

johanna.solo: Safe solo into anything and blunts AA bruisers with Glare; low kill threat means Dehaka or Leoric happily out-soak her

plan.early: Weave AAs between Fel Claws swipes, the third swipe stuns for a free trade. Necrotic Embrace shrugs poke; sleep ganks with Night Rush
plan.mid: Carrion Swarm at 10: stun with the third Fel Claws swipe, then swarm through 3+ heroes to heal back to full mid-fight
plan.fight: Night Rush their healer to sleep, chain Fel Claws stuns onto the carry. Every extra hero you hit is extra healing; fight in the pile
plan.late: Plague Bats at 16 turns swarm into a fight-winner; hard CC during it is your death. Bait stuns, then commit and outlast them

malganis.solo: Elite solo sustain: out-heals nearly every bruiser trade; ranged offlaners and healing reduction (Ana) neuter him

plan.early: Hold Storm Bolt until Thunder Clap's slow guarantees it, soak and let Second Wind top you off, Dwarf Toss over terrain resets ganks
plan.mid: Avatar at 10: pop it entering the objective fight and eat their CC as the sponge; if it is down, do not start fights
plan.fight: Peel first: Thunder Clap the divers, Storm Bolt the kill target when your team commits, Dwarf Toss out last
plan.late: Avatar plus Second Wind is near-immortal vs spell comps, but Tychus-style percent damage ignores it. Never Toss INTO five

muradin.solo: Classic safe solo: escapes any gank with Dwarf Toss and heals it off; sustain traders like Mal'Ganis slowly win the lane

plan.early: Hook only clean lanes, it stops on minions. Slam clears and dismounts roamers; Devour the bruiser to out-sustain trades
plan.mid: Gorge at 10: Hook the healer, walk them into your team, then Gorge whoever comes to save them. Hold Hook to break channels
plan.fight: One button wins it: Hook their carry into five allies. Follow with Gorge on the second target, Slam slow to peel after
plan.late: Master Hooker at 20 makes picks constant: hook from fog, never from plain sight. A missed hook means playing the fight 4v5

stitches.solo: Decent solo: Devour keeps him topped forever; percent damage (Malthael, Tychus flex) and slippery laners like Dehaka beat him

plan.early: Poke with El'druin's Might and teleport back out, Smite the wave edge for move speed rotations, Righteousness BEFORE damage lands
plan.mid: Judgment at 10 to dive carries after escapes are down; take Sanctification instead when they run Mosh or KTZ wombo
plan.fight: El'druin in, Righteousness your diver, Smite speed the chase. Even dying works: your death bomb zones their backline
plan.late: You enable the carry, not yourself: hold Sanctification for their R combo. Sancting nothing is how late fights get lost

tyrael.solo: Flex solo: very safe with El'druin escapes but low kill pressure; Arthas and Blaze out-trade him all lane

plan.early: Two players, one body: soak the safest lane, Cho lands close-range Rune Bombs so Gall detonates Runic Blast on cooldown
plan.mid: Hammer of Twilight plus Twisting Nether at 10: Surging Fist in, Hammer stun, Nether the clump; Gall never stops Shadowflame
plan.fight: You ARE the frontline: Fist their carry, Hammer the peeler, Gall dumps Shadowflame and Dread Orb nonstop. Leave at 50%, not 20%
plan.late: You feed double XP when you die: never get caught solo. C'Thun's Gift and Twilight Frenzy at 20 win any grouped fight

plan.early: Trade with Death Coil, root predictable paths with Howling Blast, toggle Frozen Tempest only in trades; it drains mana fast
plan.mid: Sindragosa at 10: hit 3+ heroes or freeze the fort before you push; disabled towers make your objective follow-up free
plan.fight: Walk through their front to the AA carry, Tempest halves attack speed, Howling Blast the dash as it starts. Enter last, no escape
plan.late: Frostmourne Hungers plus Remorseless Winter at 16 melts anyone in melee; displacement is death, so hug your team and walls

arthas.solo: Strong solo vs melee: Frozen Tempest ruins AA bruisers; ranged offlaners kite him for free and Ana cuts his self-heal

plan.early: Throw Loot Hoard for the meat heal, Staggering Blow enemies into it or walls for stuns, keep Rage above 50 by trading often
plan.mid: Hoardapult at 10: launch onto their backline at objectives, Hogg Wild spin the clump, Staggering Blow stragglers into terrain
plan.fight: Pin their carry to a wall with Staggering Blow, point-blank Ez-Thro Dynamite so it pops instantly, spin out with Hogg Wild
plan.late: No wall means no stun: pick fight locations first. Stay above 50 Rage for the armor or you fall over in seconds

hogger.solo: Premier offlaner: wins most melee matchups with wall stuns and meat sustain; poke ranged like Lunara starve him out

plan.early: Charge the bruiser through the minion line, stack Valor with W and E, consume with AAs. Flash of Anger at 7 wins every trade
plan.mid: Wrath of the Angiris at 10: lift the carry and drop them inside your team, but only when follow-up CC is ready to land
plan.fight: Lay Solarion's Fire, Charge-pin their carry along it, Molten Armor the marked target. Vs dive, save Charge to peel your healer
plan.late: Late Wraths must hit the carry with your team set to catch; you are airborne and useless for 2s, so time it as the opener

imperius.solo: Top-tier solo bully: beats Sonya, Artanis, and The Butcher head-on; ranged kiters and Sgt. Hammer deny his Charge

plan.early: Skeletal Swing slow first so the full Drain Hope channel sticks; even dead you keep soaking as Undying, so never leave lane XP
plan.mid: Entomb at 10: box the healer against a wall on the objective, Drain Hope inside while your team collapses on them
plan.fight: March at the biggest health bar, Drain their tank's percent HP, Wraith Walk through bodies to reach the healer. Die AFTER it's won
plan.late: Buried Alive at 20 removes their carry for 4s: open fights with it. Mobile heroes walk out of Entomb; trap against walls only

leoric.solo: Premier solo soaker: even his corpse soaks XP; Dehaka out-rotates him and Samuro or Tracer dodge everything he throws
